messages:
sam: Hey folks, dentist abroad says they need a pre-authorization before doing a crown. They want a prior-auth form + benefits verification. I don't have my physical card here. Any quick path?

katie (Benefits): Hi @sam  Can you share the dentist's tax ID/NPI and an itemized estimate? Most carriers accept a prior auth request submitted by the provider.

sam: Clinic NPI 998877665, estimate $1,200, appointment tomorrow morning local. They said without auth they won't start.

clinic-rep: Hi Sam  we can submit the auth if you provide member ID and plan name. We can also accept a screenshot of the member portal showing active coverage while auth is processed.

mark (People Ops): If carrier turnaround is slow, plan B: pay and get an itemized paid receipt + procedure code (D2740) and we'll file an urgent out-of-network claim/reimbursement. Also ask the clinic to bill using the member ID so carrier can match.

katie (Benefits): I'll open a carrier escalation. Sam, DM me a screenshot of your member screen, and I'll request expedited prior auth. Carrier phone (int'l): +1-800-555-0147, option 2 for authorizations.

hr-bot: Automated note  Benefits case created (PA-1122). Expected carrier response 24-72 hrs. Mark urgent if under 24.

sam: DM'd the screenshot and DM'd the clinic contact. Clinic says they'll submit on their side once they have member ID.

katie (Benefits): Thanks. Two quick tips: 1) Ask clinic to include the tooth number and exact CDT code, 2) keep a photo of the signed consent form if they proceed. We'll push the carrier for same-day if possible.

mark (People Ops): If carrier denies, we can appeal or cover a portion through our discretionary fund for urgent dental while traveling. Keep receipts.

sam: Clinic accepted screenshot and agreed to proceed with scheduling while auth is pending. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:

katie (Benefits): Great. Upload the final itemized receipt and any explanation of benefits (EOB) to the portal under Claims > Dental so we can reconcile. We'll follow up when carrier responds.

sam: Will do. Thanks team!
